extracted.intended_audience: general readers and Wikipedia editors seeking information on Munawar Faruqui
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia-style encyclopedia article summarizing a stand-up comedian's life and career, including lead, infobox, sections for early life, career, personal life, controversies, filmography/discography, and references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead summary
rubrics_metrics.description: "Munawar Faruqui (born 28 January 1994) is an Indian comedian, rapper and singer. In 2022, he won the reality TV show, Lock Upp 1. In 2023, he participated in Bigg Boss 17 and emerged as the winner." (opening lead paragraph)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise opening paragraph that summarises the subject's full name, birth date, primary occupations, and most notable achievements or claims to fame; gives readers the essential facts up front.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infobox with key facts
rubrics_metrics.description: Infobox fields shown: Born (date and place), Spouse(s) with marriage/divorce years, Years active, Medium, Genres, YouTube channel information (subscribers, views, last updated).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a compact infobox containing verifiable quick facts: birth details, family/spouse entries, career span, primary media/genres, and notable online channel stats. Use standard infobox parameters and update stats with dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article structure / section headings
rubrics_metrics.description: Page organizes content under headings including: Early life and education; Career; Personal life; Controversy; Filmography; Special appearances; Music videos; Discography; References; External links.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include clear, conventional sections for a biographical article to cover background, career chronology, personal details, controversies, and creative works. Use subsections as needed (e.g., Web series, Television, Music videos) to present filmography/discography systematically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting references / inline citations
rubrics_metrics.description: The article contains numerous numbered footnotes and source citations; some statements are marked with 'citation needed'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All factual claims should be supported by reliable, verifiable sources cited inline; unsourced or poorly sourced statements should be flagged and, if necessary, removed. Maintain a complete References section with full citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Neutral, factual encyclopedic tone
rubrics_metrics.description: The page presents facts about the subject (birth, work, controversies) in a neutral third-person tone without promotional language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write in a neutral, objective manner; avoid editorialising, unsourced allegations, or promotional phrasing. Present controversies and allegations only with reliable sourcing and factual framing (e.g., arrested under X law; granted bail).

rubrics_metrics.name: Filmography and discography formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Filmography and music credits are listed with Year, Title, Role, Notes, and references where available (e.g., Web series, Television, Music videos, Discography entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List creative works in chronological order with columns or clear lists showing year, title, role/credit, and any relevant notes (TBA, season, special appearance). Provide references for release dates and credits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controversy and legal events documented with dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Controversy section recounts specific incidents with dates and outcomes (e.g., 1 January 2021 interrupted show; 2 January 2021 arrested under hate speech laws; granted bail by Supreme Court; spent 37 days in jail).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document controversies with precise dates, the nature of allegations, official actions taken, and legal outcomes, always citing reliable sources. Avoid presenting allegations as facts without sourcing and indicate legal statuses (e.g., arrested, granted bail, not acquitted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance tags, categories and metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: The page shows categories (e.g., Indian stand-up comedians) and hidden maintenance categories such as 'Wikipedia articles in need of updating' and 'Articles with unsourced statements'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply appropriate topical categories for indexing and add maintenance templates where the article needs updates or has sourcing issues. Use hidden categories to track maintenance concerns and follow Wikipedia conventions for cleanup tags.

rubrics_metrics.name: External links and authority control
rubrics_metrics.description: External links section includes Wikimedia Commons, IMDb, and the subject's YouTube channel; authority control identifiers are present.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide links to official or authoritative external profiles (official website, major databases like IMDb, verified social channels) and include authority control metadata to improve discoverability; avoid linking to trivial or unreliable external pages.
